feeds.title: Angela J Herrington Blog
feeds.description: Angela J. Herrington, a faith deconstruction coach and certified life coach, empowers women to embrace their God-given leadership. With a seminary background, she guides individuals on personal journeys, having navigated her path to break free from learned constraints. Angela, an Enneagram 8 and Gen Xer challenges toxic teachings, advocating for authenticity and empowerment in sacred womanhood.

feeds.title: NakedPastor Blog
feeds.description: David Hayward, known as the Naked Pastor, transitioned from 30 years in ministry to pursue art. Through NakedPastor, he challenges norms, deconstructs dogma, and offers hope to spiritual refugees. His art reflects the struggles of independent thinkers questioning religion's confines. Explore and purchase his cartoons, apparel, books, and more.

feeds.title: the Way? Blog
feeds.description: Eric Hatfield, based in Sydney, Australia, has followed Jesus for over 50 years. With a theology degree and a curious mind, he offers insights on navigating faith in the 21st century through his blog, the Way? Blog. Eric's open-minded approach and extensive reading guide readers through complex issues. He also runs another website, Is there a God? for non-believers considering faith.

feeds.title: Church Anew Blog
feeds.description: Church Anew fosters innovative learning for church leaders and believers, igniting a Spirit-led movement. Operating as interconnected teams, they respond dynamically to church needs. Their mission sets an inclusive table of belonging, nurturing leaders, and empowering communities for a bold witness in the world.

feeds.title: Christy Lynne Wood Blog
feeds.description: Christy Lynne Wood, formerly in a Christian cult, encountered Jesus and embarked on a quest for the real God. Her journey, marked by paradox and mystery, explores grace and truth in uncertainty. Through her blog, podcast 'Looking for the Real God,' and social media, she invites others to join her search for authenticity and deeper understanding.

feeds.title: Lake Drive Books Blog
feeds.description: The Lake Drive Books Team comprises seasoned editors, designers, and partners dedicated to publishing transformative books. Their values include communication, equity, empowerment, humility, and integrity. With professionalism and courage, they continually seek improvement, fostering a supportive environment for each other and their mission.

feeds.title: Rohadi Nagassar Blog
feeds.description: On Decolonizing Christianity. Author: 'When We Belong. Reclaiming Christianity on the Margins.' Podcast: 'Faith in a Fresh Vibe'

feeds.title: Rebekah Drumsta Blog » Deconstruction
feeds.description: Read deconstructing articles on the blogs written by Rebekah, a consultant, writer, and advocate at RebekahDrumsta.com with the mission of supporting survivors of spiritual abuse and religious trauma by providing resources to educate and equip not only survivors but the public as well.

feeds.title: The Sophia Society Blog » Deconstruction
feeds.description: Gary Alan Taylor, co-founder of The Sophia Society and co-host of Holy Heretics, holds an M.A. in European History. With 26 years in nonprofit ministry, he advocates freedom from toxic faith. Alongside his wife Jennifer, he cherishes Dorset, England. Based in Monument, Colorado, their mission is to guide seekers towards spiritual wholeness and transformation.

feeds.title: Dr. Camden Morgante » Deconstruction
feeds.description: Dr. Camden Morgante, a licensed clinical psychologist, therapist, and professor, specializes in women's issues, relationships, trauma, and spirituality. As a writer and speaker, she addresses purity culture recovery and faith reconstruction. Her upcoming book, 'Recovering from Purity Culture,' reflects her expertise. Residing in Knoxville, Tennessee, she focuses on mental health advocacy and family life, inspiring healing and empowerment.

feeds.title: Katelynn Martin Blog
feeds.description: Katelynn Martin, raised in the Christian Church, grappled with her perceived goodness until confronted with her limitations and sinfulness. Through essays, poems, and prayers, she shares her journey of rediscovery and surrender to a compassionate, perfect God who offers healing and refuge for fragile souls.
